AnswerIn.description: ``choice`` (0-3) for multiple choice, ``value`` for true/false; exactly one (G5-ATT-05).
AnswerIn.title: AnswerIn

CourseList.description: Only the caller's own courses; no total that could count anyone else's (G1-ISO-04).
CourseList.title: CourseList

CourseSummaryCreate.description:
The selected documents, in reading order. The service checks ownership, duplicates, the maximum and readiness,
and answers with an explicit error instead of leaving any selected document out.
CourseSummaryCreate.title: CourseSummaryCreate

MessageCreate.description: Only the question and an optional document selection; scope fields are rejected (OWN-08, RET-07).
MessageCreate.title: MessageCreate

QuestionOut.description: Exactly what a student may see before submitting an attempt (ISO-04): no answer, rationale or evidence.
QuestionOut.title: QuestionOut

QuizCreate.description: Scope fields, answer keys and other question types are rejected (OWN-08, RET-07, T-6).
QuizCreate.title: QuizCreate

SavedAnswer.description: The same fields whether the answer is right or wrong (G5-KEY-02).
SavedAnswer.title: SavedAnswer

TokenResponse.description: The refresh token is never in a response body (RT-02); it travels only in its cookie.
TokenResponse.title: TokenResponse

delete.description: ISO-03: documents (vectors, parents, files, rows) first, then the course.

get.description: The stored original (FILE-05): verified media type, attachment disposition, never inline.
